shortDescription: Attack Shark X8PLUS Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse with C06 Ultra Cable White (Ultra-Lightweight 55g / Flagship PixArt PAW3395PRO Sensor Up to 40000 DPI / 700 IPS & 60G Acceleration / HUANO 100M Clicks Switches / Tri
descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark X8PLUS Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse with C06 Ultra Cable White (Ultra-Lightweight 55g / Flagship PixArt PAW3395PRO Sensor Up to 40000 DPI / 700 IPS & 60G Acceleration / HUANO 100M Clicks Switches / Tri-Mode 2.4GHz, Bluetooth & USB-C / 500mAh Battery / C06 Ultra LED Charging Cable / Official 1-Year Local Warranty)

Elevate your desktop setup and master esports precision with pure white aesthetics using the Attack Shark X8PLUS White Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered with an ultra-lightweight 55g ergonomic matte white shell tailored for medium to large hands, this flagship mouse features the ultra-precise PixArt PAW3395PRO optical sensor capable of up to 40,000 DPI, 700 IPS speed, and 60G acceleration. Equipped with durable HUANO mechanical switches rated for 100 million clicks, pure PTFE skates, a 500mAh long-lasting battery, and the premium 1.6m C06 Ultra LED charging cable, it offers ultra-fast tri-mode connectivity via 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, or wired Type-C.
